title: Buffalo, NY — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Buffalo, NY: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Buffalo is a city in NY with a population of 276,011. City of Good Neighbors with chicken wings, lake effect snow, and incredibly cheap housing. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.3.
